props.title: She Had Eleven Thousand Dollars for the Whole Year. The Focus Group Cost Fifteen.

props.text: The median U.S. community engagement budget is $11,000/year. A single focus group costs $7,000–$20,000. This article follows the person caught in that gap — the community director, the DAO lead, the solo founder — who needs to know what people think but can't afford to ask. MiroShark's $1 social simulation doesn't replace real research, but for the majority who currently have no research at all, it closes a gap that the $1,500+ synthetic research platforms never tried to reach.
